correctness.rationale: The construction on a smallest part has weight ceiling((N+m)/2) and satisfies the definition. For any candidate with z zeros, a defender in a zero-free part contributes excess at least ceiling(z/2); because that part has size at least m, z is at most N-m and the desired lower bound follows. If every defender part contains a zero, a zero in one part forces a defender in another zero-containing part, whose zero in turn forces a defender in a second part. Their two excess requirements sum to at least (2z-z_a-z_b)/2. Each defender part retains a positive vertex, and a third part has size at least m, so z_a+z_b is at most N-m-2, giving an even stronger bound. This proves the theorem for all r at least three. The package verifier is only a finite regression check.
